files=[]
for q in sorted(p.rglob('*')):

for n in ['bootstrap-receipt.json','frozen-before.json','frozen-after.json','guard-ledger.jsonl','inherited-denials.json','source_get_guard.py','run.py','write_lane.py','terminal-self-exclusions.json']:assert n in included
w('SHAmanifest.json',json.dumps({'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'files':files,'terminal_self_exclusions':ex,'completed_runner_receipt_jsons_included':sorted(receipts & included),'credit':0,'acceptance':False,'frozen_bindings_after':'12 checked; no mismatches'},indent=2))
